headline: Aramco told staff to evacuate Dhahran HQ (Reuters)
dek: Saudi Aramco told staff to evacuate its headquarters in Dhahran as fighting with Yemen's Ansar Allah intensified (Reuters). Brent rose to $112.33 (+3.2%), five-month high; WTI $99.29.
fault_line: Pocketbook first: if Aramco's own HQ is evacuating, when does $112 Brent reach your fuel bill?
